tools.name: audio_play
tools.description: Start playing an audio file through the local speakers and return at once. The audio comes from a local file path or a log:/mem: handle, such as the path or handle returned by tts_speak. It only plays sound; it does not send anything. A playback failure arrives later as an audio-play.failed event.

audio.description: Audio file path (absolute, or relative to the bot workspace) or a log:/mem: handle, e.g. the path or log: handle returned by tts_speak.

volume.description: Playback volume 0–100 for this call; omit to use the configured volume.

summary.zh: 把一段音频（本地文件或 log:/mem: 句柄，比如 tts_speak 回执里的那个）交给本机扬声器，开始播放后立刻返回；失败会发 audio-play.failed 事件，成功不再回报。
summary.en: Start playing an audio file or a log:/mem: handle (such as the one returned by tts_speak) through the local speakers and return at once; a failure arrives later as an audio-play.failed event, and success is silent.

tools.name: audio_watch
tools.description: Read or change playback settings. start turns on automatic playback of event audio for the configured event types (tts.voice by default) and plays new events that carry an audio attachment; stop turns it off; set changes the watched event types and/or the playback backend without changing whether watching is on; status shows the settings and last playback. Every change is saved to the config. Playback failures arrive as audio-play.failed events; success is silent.

action.description: start = watch new events and play their audio; stop = stop watching; set = change the watched types and/or the playback backend; status = show the current settings.

events.description: For start and set: comma-separated event types to watch, e.g. tts.voice. For start it defaults to the configured list.

backend.description: For start and set: the playback backend. auto = platform default; wpf = Windows system player; ffplay, mpv, vlc, afplay, paplay, aplay = that command; custom = the command configured in the settings.

summary.zh: 打开或关闭事件音频的自动播放，更换监听的事件类型或播放后端，或查看当前设置；播放新事件里的音频附件。
summary.en: Turn automatic playback of event audio on or off, change the watched event types or the playback backend, or read the current settings; plays audio attachments on new events.

tools.name: audio_queue
tools.description: Read or change the playback queue. list shows what is playing now and what is waiting; skip stops the current item and lets the next one start; remove drops one waiting item by id; clear stops the current item and drops everything waiting. Skipping and clearing are cancellations, not failures: no audio-play.failed event is sent. Manual plays and watched event audio share one queue; ids come from an audio_play receipt or from list.

action.description: list = current item and waiting items; skip = stop the current item; remove = drop one waiting item; clear = stop the current item and drop all waiting items.

id.description: For remove: the queue id to drop, e.g. q7. The current item cannot be removed; use skip.

summary.zh: 查看或调整播放队列：列表、跳过当前这条、按 id 移除排队中的一条、停止当前并清空队列；跳过和清空是取消，不算失败，不发失败事件。
summary.en: Read or change the playback queue: list, skip the current item, remove a waiting item by id, or stop the current item and clear the queue; skipping and clearing are cancellations, not failures, so no failure event is sent.

description.zh: 播放失败：正文带音频来源、音量与原因，没有附件；手动播放和自动播放失败都会发，成功不发。
description.en: A failed playback: the text carries the audio reference, volume and reason, with no attachment; both manual and watched playback emit it, success is silent.

changelog.0.4.0:
- 新增「队列」页：实时显示正在播放与排队中的音频，可按条移除、跳过当前、清空队列；页面关闭时不产生轮询。
- 队列变化通过 WebUI 推送更新；当前条目的已播时长在页面里本地计时。
- 新增 `cortico.webUiClient`：`dist/webui.js` 是手写的浏览器 bundle，没有构建步骤，也没有新增运行时依赖。
- 官方 `check:extension` 与自检同步覆盖面板声明、快照接口与推送。
changelog.0.3.0:
- 新增 `audio_queue`：`list` 查看当前与排队条目，`skip` 跳过当前这条，`remove` 按 id 删掉排队中的一条，`clear` 停止当前并清空队列。
- 队列从 promise 链改成显式条目，每条有 id；`audio_play` 回执带上 id（`q7`）与前面还有几条。
- 跳过和清空是取消：停掉播放器进程，不发 `audio-play.failed`。
- 手动播放与事件自动播放共用同一个队列，事件音频也能跳掉；`audio_watch status` 显示当前条目与队列深度。
- 队列只在内存里，重启应用不保留。
changelog.0.2.0:
- 新增 `worlds.audio-play.backend`：选择播放后端。`auto` 保持平台默认，也可以指定 `wpf` / `ffplay` / `mpv` / `vlc` / `afplay` / `paplay` / `aplay`，或用 `custom`。
- 新增 `worlds.audio-play.command`：后端为 `custom` 时执行自定义命令，`{file}` 与 `{volume}` 是占位符；命令不经过 shell。
- `audio_watch` 的 `set` 可以更换播放后端，`status` 会显示当前后端与自定义命令。
- `audio_play` 改为非阻塞：开始播放（或排队）后立刻返回，不再等播放结束。
- 成功不发事件；播放失败发 `audio-play.failed` 事件，正文带音频来源、音量与原因，默认投递到对话事件流。取消和 World 停止不算失败。
- 自动播放失败也发同一条事件；连续失败时 30 秒内最多通知一次，避免事件潮。
- 回执从「播放完了」改为「开始播放 / 已排队」；播放器和自动播放仍然共用一条串行队列。
- 新增空的「提示词」页（`src/ENV_PROMPT.md`）；默认不往系统前缀加内容，部署者可以补充播放约定。
- Windows 的 WPF 打不开格式时，错误提示会建议换一个后端。
changelog.0.1.1:
- 新增 `worlds.audio-play.autoPlay` 与 `watchEvents`：监听事件库里的指定事件（默认 `tts.voice`），把带音频附件的新事件播放出来；只播打开监听之后的事件，重启不补。
- 新增 `audio_watch` 工具：桌宠可以 `start` / `stop` / `set` 监听类型 / `status`，改动写入配置。
- 事件里的音频优先取附件句柄，其次取事件 meta 里的文件路径；与 `audio_play` 共用同一条播放队列。
changelog.0.1.0:
- 首个版本：`audio_play` 工具，接受本地音频路径或 `log:` / `mem:` 句柄（比如 `tts_speak` 回执里的路径与附件句柄），在本机扬声器播放并等待结束，只回成功或失败。
- Windows 用系统自带的 PowerShell + WPF MediaPlayer，macOS 用 `afplay`，Linux 依次尝试 `ffplay` / `mpv` / `paplay` / `aplay`；没有 npm 运行时依赖。
- 配置 `worlds.audio-play`：`enabled`、`volume`、`timeoutMs`；不需要密钥。
- 句柄先落成临时文件，播放结束即删；同一时间只放一段，后到的调用排队。
